scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/contract typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/app typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/desktop typecheck
scripts.fmt: bun run --cwd packages/app fmt && bun run --cwd packages/contract fmt && bun run --cwd packages/desktop fmt
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd packages/app lint && bun run --cwd packages/contract lint && bun run --cwd packages/desktop lint
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run --cwd packages/desktop rust:check
